properties.selection_rationale: Centred on the Spirit landing site (14.5684 S, 175.4726 E); the window includes the western Columbia Hills. Fixed before any terrain value was computed.
known_limitations: The window mixes plains and part of the Columbia Hills
Rover-scale observations do not validate window-scale statistics
Terrain metrics do not establish geology, habitability, safety or radiation
properties.creation_method: Planetocentric latitude, east-positive longitude on the Mars sphere (R = 3,396,190 m); processing builds a local equirectangular grid true to scale at the window latitude.
properties.planetary_target: Reference window for terrain-only comparison with Earth windows.
properties.representativeness: One 10 km window; it does not represent the whole crater or plain.
properties.known_selection_bias: Placed at a mission site by a documented rule.
